programs.description: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality.
Devotees gather to participate in devotional singing, reading of religious texts and performances throughout the night in praise of the mother goddess.
Priests and devotees from across the region perform elaborate rituals, offering heartfelt prayers and seeking blessings from the Almighty.
A religious leader encourages followers to take the path of spirituality.
Various religious singers and musicians sing devotional songs in praise of the Almighty in order to help devotees get closer to God.
Lord Shiva, a Hindu God, strives to overcome multiple challenges, demonstrating his strength and wisdom as he fulfils his cosmic duties.
Lord Ganesha, the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, fights evil forces to save the world and protect innocent disciples.
Devotees from across the region sing devotional songs and hymns, offering heartfelt prayers and seeking blessings from the Almighty.
A compilation of devotional hymns and bhajans dedicated to Maa Bhagwati is played back-to-back to praise the goddess with fervent devotion.
A mother of two children spends most of her time hoping that her husband, who has gone looking for work in the city, may return home soon. However, her patience is tested when he does not come back.
A mischievous yet kind-hearted simpleton, Durga, creates chaos in her village when her well-meaning actions often go hilariously wrong, leading to unexpected troubles for everyone around her.
Bringing the best in television.
Shalini lives in America but desires to relocate to India. Meanwhile, a girl from Patna called Indira wishes to travel to a foreign country.
